claim_boundary: This contract discriminates only the P1424 fragment listed in the manifest. It does not establish general HTML or SVG equivalence and does not compare SVG bytes, IDs, path text, or attribute order.

classification.Preserved: All required public-language observations for the case are established with an attributable witness.
classification.Unknown: Identity, execution, parsing, extraction, dependency, or budget prevents a sound decision. Unknown is fail-closed and cannot satisfy a mandatory case or reject a mutation.
classification.Violated: At least one required observation differs, with a public witness naming the observable and actual result.

exhaustive_wiring.fail_closed: Any additional E0004 Content consumer, wildcard introduced to suppress review, missing owner L0 update, or unallowlisted compilation repair invalidates R2.

mutations.mutation: Implement frame as HtmlElem with tag frame or another sentinel tag.
Erase HtmlFrame to Empty or bare body during construction.
Register frame through the generic typed-tag table or accept named/extra arguments.
Export the body as ordinary HTML/text or silently omit the occurrence instead of inline SVG.
Reuse standalone page SVG including A4 canvas, page background, or non-intrinsic dimensions.
Emit a paged wrapper, margin, item, or second island for HtmlFrame.
Resolve the island under the outer HTML target rather than a localized paged target.
Discard occurrence-effective styles, text size, metrics, image sizing, or font context.
Resolve a nested frame as a second inline SVG or independent geometry.
Escape generated SVG as HTML text or wrap it in a paragraph/frame tag.
Paginate the whole HTML document or enter frame resolution when no frame exists.
Activate Feature::Html because the selected target or format is HTML.
Convert unsupported layout/render, timeout, or opaque extraction into successful empty output.

observables.O-BINDING-FEATURE: Binding availability follows Feature::Html independently of target; format never enables feature.
observables.O-CARRIER: Construction and reflection preserve the distinct frame carrier and body morphology until the target-specific consumer.
observables.O-FAIL-CLOSED: Unsupported, ambiguous, crashed, timed-out, unreadable, or unresolved occurrences never become successful omission or empty output.
observables.O-GEOMETRY-PAINT-TEXT: Intrinsic dimensions, viewBox, transparency, supported paint, and visible text are compared semantically with 0.001pt geometric tolerance where numeric extraction is required.
observables.O-HTML-INLINE-SVG: HTML places one unescaped inline svg at the occurrence, block-level by default, without frame tag, paragraph wrapper, page background, or A4 canvas.
observables.O-LITERAL-FRAME-TAG: html.elem("frame") remains a literal DOM element and is not the primitive.
observables.O-NESTING: Nested primitive frames collapse to the same supported geometry and visual morphology as one frame.
observables.O-PAGED-TRANSPARENCY: Paged layout delegates once to the body and adds no wrapper, offset, margin, page, or geometry.
observables.O-SIGNATURE: Exactly one positional required Content body is accepted; missing, named, and extra positional forms retain their public diagnostics.

revision.reason: Adds the minimal complete fail-closed Content exhaustive-wiring set found by the baseline compiler audit; public claims, cases, mutation expectations, Unknown policy and claim boundary are unchanged.

unknown_policy: Fail closed exactly as frozen in the manifest. Unknown is acceptable only as the expected result of U01-U04; it blocks P01-P13, contributes neither numerator nor rejection credit, and prevents sealing when produced by a required positive or a valid mutation.
